name: Alphalete - Local Page Rewrite Briefs 2026-07-14
body:
> Plan · Alphalete · 2026-07-14

# Summary
An analysis-only audit (Jul 14 2026, no live changes) of the 220 local service x city pages (5 service groups x 44 cities), plus a research brief for every page slated for rewrite and 4 finished Colorado Springs drafts. Because the briefs are per service with one section per city, this is one table note rather than one note per city.

# Key finding: duplication by service group
| Group | Pages | Avg unique content | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial trenchless pipelining | 44 | 56.6% | KEEP 30 (Tier A + B), KEEP* 14 (Tier C, optional noindex) |
| Drain cleaning | 44 | 36.2% | REWRITE 30, REWRITE-LIGHT 14 |
| Hydro jetting | 44 | 38.7% | REWRITE 30, REWRITE-LIGHT 14 |
| Trenchless sewer repair (residential) | 44 | 12.6% | REWRITE 30, REWRITE-LIGHT 14 |
| Sewer camera inspection | 44 | 8.1% | REWRITE 30, REWRITE-LIGHT 14 |

Only the commercial group was genuinely differentiated (3-word shingle overlap 0.49). The other four were near-duplicate city swaps (overlap 0.85 to 0.94), and the one local nugget per city was reused across all four services.

# City tiers
- **A (14):** Colorado Springs, Denver, Pueblo, Castle Rock, Parker, Littleton, Lone Tree, Fountain, Monument, Canon City, Woodland Park, Security-Widefield, Manitou Springs, Black Forest.
- **B (16):** Palmer Lake, Elizabeth, Peyton, Larkspur, Florence, Cripple Creek, Penrose, Cascade, Green Mountain Falls, Franktown, Sedalia, Calhan, Victor, Florissant, Elbert, Kiowa.
- **C (14):** Boone, Buffalo Creek, Coal Creek, Guffey, Lake George, Louviers, Matheson, Pine, Ramah, Rockvale, Simla, Wetmore, Yoder, USAF Academy. Light rewrite only: county and terrain differentiation, no invented local detail.

# Service angles (keep the four city pages distinct from each other)
| Service | URL pattern at the time | Angle |
|---|---|---|
| Trenchless sewer repair | `/service-areas/trenchless-sewer-repair-{city}/` | Residential no-dig repair; protect yards and driveways; aging clay, Orangeburg, cast iron laterals |
| Drain cleaning | `/service-areas/drain-cleaning-services-in-{city}/` | Clearing plus diagnosis; recurring vs one-off clogs; when a clog is a pipe defect |
| Hydro jetting | `/service-areas/hydro-jetting-services-in-{city}/` | Heavy buildup: grease, mineral scale, root masses; when jetting beats snaking |
| Sewer camera inspection | `/services/sewer-camera-inspections-in-{city}/` | Diagnostic and real-estate due diligence; HD video the customer keeps |

# Drafts written (Colorado Springs only)
| Service | Draft | Target post |
|---|---|---|
| Trenchless sewer repair | `drafts\tsr_colorado-springs.md` | post 6250 (master, do not overwrite) |
| Drain cleaning | `drafts\drain_colorado-springs.md` | post 10056 |
| Hydro jetting | `drafts\hydro_colorado-springs.md` | post 10064 (master) |
| Sewer camera inspection | `drafts\sci_colorado-springs.md` | post 10196 |

# Guardrails in the briefs
No fake reviews, ratings, response times, prices or job examples. No invented neighborhoods for Tier C. Strip "50-year" claims. NAP stays Colorado Springs. Unconfirmed detail is marked NEEDS VERIFICATION. Note: the briefs and drafts put (720) 807-3224 in metas and say the 20-year warranty is real; later rules ban phone numbers in metas and hold warranty wording for the Agency owner (see [Alphalete - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-alphalete-decisions-and-rules)).

# Status
Superseded in structure: in August the city pages moved to root slugs with one primary service per city (44 pages). The evidence cards and angles are still useful input for the Step 6 local-proof pilot in [Alphalete - Lesson Fix Steps 2026-10-08](lib:brain-alphalete-lesson-fix-steps-2026-10-08).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `README.md`: overview, action summary and tiers.
- `AUDIT_full_220.csv`: one row per page with tier, group, action, rationale, post ID, permalink and title.
- `unique_content_report.csv`: measured unique vs boilerplate content per page.
- `briefs\MASTER_{tsr,drain,hydro,sci}.md`: reusable per-service briefs (intent, structure, metadata formula, schema, linking).
- `briefs\EVIDENCE_CARDS.md`: per-city verified local anchors (county, soils, districts) and NEEDS VERIFICATION flags.
- `briefs\PAGEBRIEFS_{tsr,drain,hydro,sci}.md`: assembled brief per city page.
- `drafts\`: the 4 Colorado Springs drafts above.
